description: This file implements the ServerLoopImpl class for managing a server loop in the Android Emulator's Cuttlefish project, including process monitoring, handling client commands, powerwash procedures, and restarting the virtual device.

classes.name: ServerLoopImpl
classes.description: Implements the server loop for managing client commands, process monitoring, and device state transitions in the Cuttlefish Android emulator environment.

methods.name: CreateQcowOverlay
methods.description: Creates a QCOW2 overlay image using the crosvm binary, with specified backing file and output path.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::ServerLoopImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the server loop with configuration, instance info, snapshot control files, and WebRTC controller.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::LateInject
methods.description: Performs late dependency injection of command sources.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::Run
methods.description: Main server loop handling client connections, commands, and extended actions.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::ResultSetup
methods.description: Sets up the server socket for listening to client connections.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::HandleExtended
methods.description: Handles extended launcher actions such as suspend, resume, snapshot, screen recording, and screenshot display.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::HandleActionWithNoData
methods.description: Handles client commands that do not require additional data, such as stop, fail, status, powerwash, and restart.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::DeleteFifos
methods.description: Removes FIFO files used for communication with the VM.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::PowerwashFiles
methods.description: Performs powerwash by deleting files and creating blank images, including overlays.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::RestartRunCvd
methods.description: Restarts the run_cvd process, optionally restoring device state.

methods.name: ServerLoopImpl::VmControlSocket
methods.description: Returns the control socket path for the VM managed by crosvm.
